Backend coverage: Bank Data v3 shape + menunggu→diambil transition on claim; takeover (admin replaces PIC, staff 403); watch on+off with notify on comment; release with reason (creator notified, distribution_status=menunggu); send/mirror to division (mirror_board_ids + division_ids + bank-data listing + andi notification) and send direct to user (member_ids set); comments PATCH (edit-own OK, edit-other 403, edited_at set); reactions toggle + notify author + invalid emoji 400; checklist rename, assignee+due, reorder, convert-to-card (item marked done, new card created in same list); custom_fields + cover_color + start_date PATCH persists; link attachments (valid + 400 for invalid URL); GET /calendar returns due-date cards; board create with template=skor generates 7 SKOR lists; POST /boards/{id}/copy?with_cards=true; archive→unarchive→ /boards-archived (403 for staff); list copy with cards (name has ' (salinan)'), archive-all-cards, move-list (staff 403, admin OK), archived flag. Frontend: BankData page + create modal + division options load + workload panel visible. Calendar page renders month grid, prev/next changes month label ('Agustus 2026'→'September 2026'). '/' shortcut focuses global-search-input. Board view exposes board-copy-link-button; card modal exposes send-work-button, watch-button, copy-link-button, card-start-date-input, cf-add-button, comment-attachment-button, link-attachment-open. SendWorkDialog exposes send-division-select/send-note-input/send-submit-button (mode/list/priority/due testids conditional on user picking a division & opening 'Opsi Tambahan' — verified by code review, not runtime because test flow did not select division first). Staff elis on bank-data does not see bankdata-takeover-* buttons (verified admin does; staff flow blocked by /login not redirecting after /logout — not iteration-3 scope).

issues: Spec mentions admin-tab-boards testid but implementation uses 'tab-trigger-boards' (Radix Tabs default). Not a bug but a naming mismatch vs spec.

send-mode-division/user, send-list-select, send-priority-select, send-due-input are conditional (require picking a division and toggling 'Opsi Tambahan'). Confirmed via source review; consider rendering hidden with display:none to make automated presence checks easier.

action_items: SEED DRIFT: elis@ali.id password hash no longer matched Staff123! at test start (verify_password=False even though hash prefix $2b$12$). I reset it via direct DB update to unblock tests. Root cause likely a prior admin PATCH of that user during iter2 UI testing. Recommend: make seed idempotent — on boot, ensure demo staff passwords are reset if they don't verify (or lock demo users from role/password changes).
Consider surfacing send-mode-* radios (or hidden placeholders) unconditionally to match testid spec used by automation.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_work.send_item: uses first non-archived board of target division as mirror target (db.boards.find_one — no sort). If division has multiple boards, target board selection is non-deterministic. Consider sorting by created_at or name for stability.

routes_work.send_item: distribution_status is overwritten to 'menunggu' when member_ids body is empty even if the card was already 'diambil' by existing members. Confirm this is intended (mirrors to bank data as menunggu). Currently existing member_ids are preserved (list merged), which may confuse UI (status=menunggu while member_ids non-empty).

routes_admin.copy_board with_cards=True: copies checklists (including entry-requirement checklists) verbatim but strips member_ids/watchers — good; but does NOT reset checklist item done flags — could copy 'done' items into a fresh board.

routes_admin.copy_list: dict(c) preserves _id from the source Mongo doc; clean_many strips '_id' before, but the loop uses `nc = dict(c)` on cleaned dict (_id already removed) — OK. Position collisions possible because cards keep same position values as source list.

routes_work.release_item: signature `body: ReleaseBody = None` combined with FastAPI is unusual; when client sends empty body, FastAPI passes default (None) — code guards with `body.reason if body else ''`. Consider Optional[ReleaseBody] = Body(default=None) for clarity.

routes_work.link_attachment stores external_url but download_attachment endpoint only serves storage_path; frontend must render link attachments via external_url — verify UI handles content_type=='link'.
routes_work.watch_item does not broadcast_item; watchers list won't sync to other viewers of the card until next fetch. Minor.
routes_admin.copy_board with_cards clones original card.position — could cause duplicates ordering issues if multiple cards share list. Consider re-normalizing positions.

rca of the issue: Elis login 401 during test setup: password_hash for elis@ali.id in DB did not verify against 'Staff123!'. Reproduce: `verify_password('Staff123!', user.password_hash)` returns False even though hash format is valid $2b$12$. Likely mutated in a prior iteration when admin UI updated the user (PATCH /api/users/{id} with password field re-hashes). Mitigation: reset via `hash_password('Staff123!')` + clear login_attempts. Long-term: seed.py should re-set demo passwords to canonical value on startup (idempotent) OR block admin from editing seeded demo accounts.
